performance.verdict: Paid is dead; organic is fading — August prove-it month has no engine.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across all 28 days — Meta and Google both $0. No leads generated. Campaigns are paused or deactivated, gutting the August scoreboard.
Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) still unresolved: 54 GBP calls in 28 days have no lead record in GHL, making the scoreboard blind to inbound intent.
Sync items + contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) overdue: GHL shows 93 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments, suggesting intake pipeline is unverifiable.
GBP actions collapsed 78% week-over-week; last 3 days (Aug 27–29) recorded 0 actions vs prior 3-day avg of ~4.3 — a confirmed 3-day signal, not noise.
GA4 sessions dropped 43% week-over-week; last 3 days averaged 7 sessions vs prior 3-day avg of 12.3 — organic web interest is softening with no paid traffic to offset it.

suggestions.text: Immediately confirm why Meta and Google campaigns are at $0 spend and reactivate or escalate — 28 days of zero spend in prove-it month.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta and Google Ads have recorded $0 spend across all 28 days through Aug 29 — campaigns appear paused or deactivated. Confirm campaign status in both ad managers and reactivate per the 7/19 call budget direction (Google/LSA priority). Success check: at least one active campaign with confirmed spend by 2026-09-02.

suggestions.text: Close phone-match attribution gap (overdue Aug 7): 54 GBP calls are invisible to GHL, breaking the lead-to-patient scoreboard.
suggestions.monday_update: Two SOW milestones are overdue: phone-match attribution (due Aug 7) and sync/contact cleanup (due Aug 14). 54 GBP calls in the 28-day window have no corresponding GHL lead record, and 93 GHL opportunities show 0 won and 0 appointments — the pipeline is unauditable. Both must be closed before the end of August or the client's scoreboard cannot be evaluated. Success check: inbound calls mapping to GHL contacts and at least one appointment reflected in pipeline by 2026-09-06.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP: 3 consecutive zero-action days (Aug 27–29) after avg 4.3/day — check for listing suppression or penalty by Sep 2.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit zero for the last 3 consecutive days (Aug 27–29), down from a prior 3-day average of approximately 4.3 actions/day and a 28-day total of 188 actions. This is a confirmed 3-day signal. Check the GBP listing for suppression, suspension notice, or category changes. If actions remain at zero by 2026-09-02, escalate as a listing issue requiring immediate remediation.
